decision_notes: Official Landtag explanation establishes state legislation, election/control/no-confidence of the government, budget approval and audit scrutiny. First-level Austrian state legislature. Primary evidence: https://www.tirol.gv.at/landtag/unser-parlament/aufgaben/

Official live page links the Landtag channel. Morning and afternoon of 1 October 2026 play at quarter-length timestamps. Both sampled videos visibly include a sign-language interpretation inset; its language and service-wide coverage remain unreviewed.
